intro.experience.issue: Ambiguous English source. 'Experience' could be a noun (section title) or an imperative verb (call to action). 'تجربة' is the noun form. If intended as an imperative, it would be 'جرّب' (jarrab) or 'ابدأ التجربة' (ibda' at-tajriba).

intro.playWelcome.issue: The current translation 'تشغيل الترحيب' is a noun phrase ('The playing of the welcome'), which sounds less natural for a UI action than an imperative verb. For a button or action, an imperative is more direct.
